description: A white square base tray with four round corner recesses sits on a green surface, with a small white rectangular block piece nearby. The left hand steadies the base on its left edge as the right hand picks up the block, moves it over the base, and lowers it upright into a central socket, adjusting it with small rotations and presses until it stands straight; the base is a left-hand object and the block is a right-hand object.
